# ADO305: runtime-parameter-reference

A runtime expression references compile-time parameters.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Category** | Expressions |
| **Default severity** | warning |
| **Enabled by default** | yes |
| **Checked on** | each original source file, before template expansion |

## Description

Parameters are only available during template expansion. Use ${{ parameters.name }} in conditions and $[ ] variable expressions instead of a bare parameters.name reference. Parameters used this way are not also reported as unused.

## Example

Problem:

```yaml
condition: and(failed(), eq(parameters.debug, true))
```

Instead:

```yaml
condition: and(failed(), eq(${{ parameters.debug }}, true))
```

## Configuration

Change the severity or turn the rule off in `.adolint.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  ADO305: off   # off | info | warning | error
```

Or on the command line: `adolint lint --disable ADO305` or `--enable ADO305`.

Suppress a single finding with a comment on the line before it (or `disable-line` at the end of the line):

```yaml
# adolint:disable-next-line ADO305
```
